description:
The requirement is for the providing of Network Components Media Converters to the U.S. Mission. The Contractor shall provide all necessary managerial, administrative and direct labor personnel as well as all transportation, tools, instrumentation, equipment and supplies required to perform the Services.
Please note this solicitation is not ready to be issued as of this date. US Embassy Nepal will launch the solicitation on the SAM.gov website when it is available.
The contractor must be an Authorized seller of the Original Equipment Manufacturer. All responsible sources may submit a quotation, which will be considered.
